scope: Standard_MMgrOpt mapped FreeMemory releases the physical Unix prefix
closes_prior_limit: The earlier partial-free audit documented logical-only prefix trimming with Vec backing retained; Unix prefixes now call munmap and Linux mincore verifies release.

native_probe.observed: page=4096 mapped_size=1 mapped_zero=1 partial_tail=1 zero_size_noop=1 malloc_size=1 malloc_zero=1 heap_free_size_ignored=1 prefix_unmapped=1 tail_mapped=1

validated_behavior: A request to free page_size + 1 bytes releases exactly two pages on the pinned Linux build.
mincore reports the released prefix as unmapped and the remaining suffix as mapped.
The suffix remains readable and writable until its final release.
Dropping or fully releasing the owned mapping calls munmap for the remaining range.
remaining_limits: Non-Unix targets retain the existing aligned heap-backed fallback; physical mapping parity is not claimed there.
Heap allocations remain Vec-backed and do not claim malloc allocator identity.
Rust rejects oversized free ranges instead of reproducing native behavior that may unmap adjacent mappings.
OS allocation and munmap failure details beyond the tested valid-range path remain unverified.
